source: Light is a wave of linked electric and magnetic fields moving through empty space at c = fλ.
Students think electromagnetic waves need a medium to travel through, or that radio waves are a kind of sound.

In The Electromagnetic Spectrum you met the family of light, from radio to gamma rays. Now we can say what light is. Faraday's Law says a changing magnetic field makes an electric field. In the 1860s James Clerk Maxwell found the partner: a changing electric field makes a magnetic field. Each one keeps making the other, and the pair travels away as a wave.

An electromagnetic wave is linked electric and magnetic fields, at right angles to each other and to the direction of travel, rising and falling together, with $E = cB$. In a vacuum every EM wave moves at $c = 3.00 \times 10^{8}\ \text{m/s}$, and $c = f\lambda$. No medium is needed.
The electric field (in one plane) and the magnetic field (in the plane at right angles) peak together as the wave moves.

Maxwell computed the speed of such a wave from two constants measured on lab benches with charges and currents, $c = 1/\sqrt{\mu_0\varepsilon_0}$, and got the measured speed of light. That match was the clue that light is an electromagnetic wave. Any accelerating charge makes these waves: electrons sloshing in a radio antenna, or jumping in an atom. The wave's electric part is the same kind of field as in The Electric Field: it pushes on charges, which is how a receiving antenna picks up the signal.

Two common mix-ups. (1) Thinking EM waves need a medium. Sunlight crosses $150$ million km of nearly empty space. (2) Thinking radio waves are a kind of sound. Sound is a pressure wave in matter at about $343\ \text{m/s}$; radio is light at $3.00 \times 10^{8}\ \text{m/s}$. A radio turns the radio wave into sound with its speaker.
An FM station broadcasts at $100\ \text{MHz}$. Find the wavelength.
$\lambda = 3.00\ \text{m}$, about the length of a car.
An EM wave has an electric field amplitude of $30\ \text{V/m}$. Find its magnetic field amplitude.
$B = 1.0 \times 10^{-7}\ \text{T}$. Tiny, but it moves in step with $E$.
The whole spectrum on one ruler. Every band is the same kind of wave, at a different frequency.
